description:
(Paid; not available through MCP.) For every axis other than the substance's own, what that axis says (with a per-cell source) kept separate from what was derived from it; when nothing can be concluded, a refusal says why and what would settle it.
This tool does not return that data: it returns the HTTP endpoint (GET /v1/substances/{id}/diff, 0.01 USDC per request via x402 on Base) to call instead.

id.description: Substance id as returned by search_substances or analyze_label, e.g. eu:e951, jp:designated-aspartame, us:cfr-172-804.

name: get_substance_diff
title: One substance, with the cross-axis derivation (paid, HTTP only)
